s.zh: \n\n选中迷锁之门，用“进入”带人和物资下去。里面可以随时进出补给；打倒守护者就算解开这一层。
s.en: \n\nSelect the mythal gate and use "enter" to take people and supplies down. You can go in and out for supplies anytime; defeating the guardian solves the floor.

s.zh: 守护者倒下了，迷锁把这一层的力量还给了解开它的人。
s.en: The guardian has fallen, and the mythal returns this floor's power to those who solved it.

s.en: Everyone in the dungeon went down. The mythal didn't devour them, but spat them back out at the gate (wounded).

s.en: rolled back: the next entry has a new layout, with monsters at full health.

s.en: (1.60.0) A mythal gate next to the spawn point: fight down floor by floor, defeating each floor's guardian for adventurer XP, mythal shards and treasure, after which it seals for a few days and reorganizes. When off, the gate stays in place and can't be entered.
